tools.name: get_prayer_times
tools.description: Daily prayer times (Fajr, sunrise, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib, Isha) for a city or coordinates, for a date or up to 31 days, with the Hijri date.

tools.name: get_ramadan_timetable
tools.description: Sahur (ends at Fajr) and iftar (Maghrib) times for every day of this or the next Ramadan in a city, with the expected or announced first day and Eid al-Fitr.

tools.name: get_qibla_direction
tools.description: The Qibla bearing (direction of the Kaaba in Mecca) from a city or coordinates, in degrees from true north, with the distance.

tools.name: get_islamic_calendar
tools.description: The Hijri date for a day, the next key Islamic dates (Ramadan, Eid al-Fitr, Day of Arafah, Eid al-Adha, Islamic New Year, ...) and month starts announced by Islamic authorities.

tools.name: find_halal_restaurants
tools.description: Halal restaurants near a city or coordinates, nearest first, with each one's CHDA halal assurance code in words (who stands behind the halal status, the kitchen, alcohol), cuisines, HalalTrip Gastronomy Awards and its HalalTrip page.

tools.name: find_places_to_pray
tools.description: Mosques and prayer rooms (musholla, surau) near a city or coordinates, nearest first, with listed facilities (Jumu'ah, women's prayer area, wudu) and each one's HalalTrip page.

tools.name: get_airport_prayer_rooms
tools.description: The prayer rooms inside one airport: terminal, where in the terminal, airside or landside, opening hours and where the details come from (often the airport operator).

tools.name: get_inflight_prayer_times
tools.description: Prayer times during a flight, worked out along the route at cruising altitude: which prayers fall in the air (in both airports' local time), which before departure and after arrival, and the Qibla relative to the aircraft's nose. Flights up to 20 hours.

tools.name: list_calculation_methods
tools.description: The prayer time calculation methods HalalTrip supports, with the ids to pass as method.
